common.stableChannelDescription: We recommend that you use this channel for all production app releases. About once a quarter, a branch that has been stabilised to beta becomes our next stable branch and we create a stable version of that branch.
common.betaChannelDescription: Branch created for a new beta release at the beginning of the month, usually the first Monday, by master. This will contain a branch for Dart, the engine and the framework.
common.devChannelDescription: The last fully tested build. Usually working, but see "Bad builds" for a list of known "bad" Dev builds.
common.masterChannelDescription: The latest tip-of-tree, absolutely latest cutting edge build. Usually functional, though sometimes we accidentally break things.

cleaner.title: Memory Clean
cleaner.headerDescription: Automatically scan and reclaim disk space from temporary build caches created by Xcode, Simulator, Flutter, Gradle, and Docker without affecting your source code.
cleaner.cleanAllSafeDialogContent:
This will safely clean caches including: Flutter Projects Build Cache, Xcode DerivedData, Xcode Caches, Simulator Unavailable, Flutter Pub Cache, and Android Gradle Cache.

All your projects and source code remain completely intact. Tools will automatically recompile or download dependencies as needed.
cleaner.confirmPrompt: Are you sure you want to clean this item?
cleaner.noProjectsWithCache: No Flutter projects with build cache found.

flutterProjectsBuild.title: Flutter Projects Build Cache
flutterProjectsBuild.subtitle: Build artifacts in past or inactive Flutter projects
flutterProjectsBuild.description: Scans macOS Spotlight index to locate Flutter projects and cleans accumulated 'build/' directories using 'flutter clean'. Frees gigabytes from projects you tested or haven't worked on recently.

xcodeDerivedData.title: Xcode DerivedData
xcodeDerivedData.subtitle: Temporary build cache from Xcode
xcodeDerivedData.description: Deletes intermediate build files created during iOS and macOS compilation. 100% safe to delete; Xcode will automatically rebuild when you open a project.

xcodeCaches.title: Xcode Caches & Logs
xcodeCaches.subtitle: Application cache and logs from Xcode
xcodeCaches.description: Cleans internal caches and logs from Xcode. Reclaims disk space and resolves slow indexing or build freeze issues.

simulatorUnavailable.title: iOS Simulator Unavailable & Caches
simulatorUnavailable.subtitle: Device caches and uninstalled simulator runtimes
simulatorUnavailable.description: Safely removes simulators belonging to deprecated or uninstalled iOS runtimes and cleans simulator runtime cache files.

flutterPubCache.title: Flutter Pub Cache
flutterPubCache.subtitle: Cached packages from pub get
flutterPubCache.description: Cleans cached dependencies downloaded via pub get. Flutter will re-download required packages when you run pub get.

androidGradleCache.title: Android Gradle Cache & Daemons
androidGradleCache.subtitle: Gradle dependencies and build cache
androidGradleCache.description: Deletes downloaded Gradle dependencies, plugins, and build artifacts. Gradle will automatically re-download them during your next Android build.

androidNdk.title: Android NDK
androidNdk.subtitle: Native Development Kit downloads for Android
androidNdk.description: Each NDK version takes 3GB to 5GB of storage. If you do not compile native C/C++ code for Android, you can remove them to reclaim disk space.

dockerSystemPrune.title: Docker System Prune
dockerSystemPrune.subtitle: Stopped containers, dangling images, and build cache
dockerSystemPrune.description: Cleans all stopped containers, unused networks, dangling images, and build cache from Docker.
